 Justice Sashikanta Mishra
 Order
Order No. 19.10.2023
01. 1. This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
2. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State.

3. The Petitioner is apprehending arrest in connection with Joda P.S. Case No.257 of 2023 corresponding to Spl. Case No.32 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned A.D.J.-cum-Spcial Judge,
Champua for the alleged commission of offence under Sections 417/376(2)(n) of IPC read with Section 3(1)(r)(s)/3(2)(v)(va) of the SC & ST (POA) Act.

4. In view of the order passed by this Court in the case of Pramod Kumar Ray and others vs. State of Odisha, reported in (2017) 16 OCR 309, the ABLAPL is disposed of directing the Petitioner to surrender before the Court below within three weeks from today.

sentences.text: It is further directed that seven days before such surrender, the Petitioner shall cause required copy of the bail application to be served on learned Special Public Prosecutor for serving notice on the victim.

5. In the event of surrender of the Petitioner as aforesaid, he shall be released on interim bail by learned Court below for such duration and on such terms and conditions as it may deem fit and proper to impose.
6. The bail application shall be finally disposed of by learned Court below within three weeks from the date of appearance of the victim.
